stocks:UBER.standing: Shares in Uber, the largest ride-hailing and food-delivery platform outside China, listed in New York. The price tracks how many trips and orders it brokers and how much of each fare it keeps.
stocks:UBER.recent: The one story about Uber's own business came after the last close shown. Consumer Reports looked into how its AI pricing sets fares and found that same-minute quotes for one trip differed by 42.4%. Nothing earlier in the input accounts for the share price.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-octob.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states whose coasts form the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait before its deadline. About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through that channel.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-octob.recent: Iran's offers to reopen Hormuz came as its own terms, a 7-day plan on Press TV and then a reopening within 6 days, and named no role for Oman. Guards said mines set tankers ablaze, a supertanker among them, Iran's strait authority blacklisted 122 ships, and the mediator in Tehran is Lavrov.

wiki-volodymyr-zelenskyy.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the former actor and comedian elected Ukraine's president in 2019, who has led the country through Russia's full-scale invasion.
wiki-volodymyr-zelenskyy.recent: Russia struck a Kharkiv power plant after Trump's energy truce, and South Korea recalled its Kyiv envoy the same day. Ukraine then went 3 days without US missile warnings, Bessent attacked Zelenskyy for faulting Washington over Starlink throttling, and Witkoff left the Oslo talks for Moscow as the warnings were restored.

poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Yemen's Houthi movement and Saudi Arabia agree a ceasefire by the end of October. Its price is what traders will stake on a truce, and Gulf oil exports and Red Sea shipping ride on it.
poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.recent: Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport emptied the capital's skies, and Qatar Airways suspended flights to Riyadh and Dammam. Houthi missiles then killed at least 18 recruits at a camp in Shabwa, while Britain sent Typhoons to intercept Houthi missiles over Saudi Arabia, Egypt's council approved troops and Turkey submitted a pact binding it to defend Riyadh.

stocks:IBM.standing: The century-old American computing company, which earns most of its money from software such as Red Hat and from consulting for large enterprises and governments, and still builds the mainframes many banks run on.

stocks:AVGO.standing: A US chipmaker that designs the custom AI accelerators and networking silicon the largest cloud companies build their data centres on. It also owns VMware, whose software runs much of the world's corporate server estate.

wiki-saudi-arabia.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Saudi Arabia, the Gulf kingdom that is the world's largest oil exporter and the guardian of Mecca and Medina. It counts how many people looked the country up, not what happened there.
wiki-saudi-arabia.recent: A Houthi missile struck Riyadh's airport, killing 13 and wounding over 300, and Qatar Airways suspended flights to Riyadh and Dammam. Allies then lined up behind the kingdom: Egypt approved troops, Britain is sending RAF Typhoons to intercept Houthi missiles, and Turkey submitted a pact binding it to defend Riyadh.

stocks:NDAQ.standing: Runs the Nasdaq Stock Market and exchanges in the Nordics and Baltics, and earns more from market data, index licensing and anti-fraud software than from trades. Funds that track the Nasdaq-100 pay it a licence fee.
stocks:NDAQ.recent: Nasdaq joined Broadcom and Verizon in objecting to the SEC's framework for tokenized stocks, but that came after the window closed. Nothing else in the input concerns the company's own business or accounts for the share's moves.

stocks:VZ.standing: One of the three national US mobile carriers alongside AT&T and T-Mobile, also selling home broadband and fibre. It carries heavy debt from spectrum purchases, and its large dividend makes it an income stock for many holders.
stocks:VZ.recent: Shares fell hardest when SpaceX struck a nationwide low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile, bringing a satellite rival onto the airwaves carriers sell, and AT&T dropped alongside it. Separately, Verizon joined Broadcom and Nasdaq in objecting to the SEC framework that lets crypto venues such as OKX list tokens of its stock without its consent.

poly-trump-putin-and-xi-seen-together-be.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US, Russian and Chinese leaders meet together in person before 2027. A three-way meeting would put Beijing at the table on matters Washington and Moscow usually settle between themselves.
poly-trump-putin-and-xi-seen-together-be.recent: Putin proposed in Moscow a summit that would seat him, Trump and Xi to settle a Ukraine deal, with no Ukrainian at the table. A day later Witkoff left talks in Oslo for Moscow, after Zelenskyy said the US had restored warnings of Russian air attacks.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority in the US House of Representatives at the 2026 midterms. The House controls federal spending and can open investigations into the White House.

poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes the Claude models, announces bankruptcy by 2029. Traders are betting on whether the cost of training frontier models outruns the lab's funding.

stocks:SPLS.standing: A PIMCO exchange-traded fund that pairs exposure to US stocks with an actively managed bond portfolio, so its price reflects both the American equity market and the bond returns its managers add on top.

stocks:DTE.DE.standing: Germany's former state phone monopoly, based in Bonn, and Europe's largest telecom operator by revenue. Most of its earnings come from its controlling stake in T-Mobile US, so the dollar and American wireless competition move it.

stocks:ORA.PA.standing: France's largest telecoms operator, formerly the state monopoly France Télécom, selling mobile and broadband across Europe and Africa. The French state remains its largest shareholder.

stocks:TEF.MC.standing: Spain's former state telephone monopoly, which runs Movistar at home, O2 in Germany and Vivo in Brazil. Its heavy debt and Latin American earnings tie the share to interest rates and the Brazilian real.

stocks:VOD.standing: Vodafone, one of Europe's largest mobile operators, based in England with networks across Europe and, through Vodacom, Africa. This is its US-listed share, priced in dollars, so sterling moves reach it too.

stocks:VSAT.standing: A Carlsbad, California satellite operator that bought Inmarsat in 2023. It sells broadband to airlines, ships and the US military from geostationary orbit, and competes with low-orbit fleets such as Starlink.

stocks:ETL.PA.standing: A Paris-listed satellite operator that runs geostationary broadcast satellites and the OneWeb low-orbit broadband constellation, Europe's main commercial alternative to Starlink.

stocks:VOW3.DE.standing: Europe's largest carmaker, based in Wolfsburg and owner of Audi, Porsche, Skoda and SEAT. Its shares price whether a combustion-era giant can sell electric cars in China and keep its German plants full.
stocks:VOW3.DE.recent: The only company news in the input landed after this window closed: Volkswagen plans to give 660,000 workers no raises until 2030, a pay freeze across its global workforce. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before it.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by November 2. Its price is what traders will stake on a deal that would reopen the Gulf's main oil export route.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.recent: Mid-month, headlines asked whether the US would drop the 'Mother of All Bombs' on Iran. Then Araghchi offered a 7-day Hormuz reopening plan, cut to 6 days the next day, and Gulf states sent Lavrov to Tehran to press Iran. Against that, the IRGC says mines set a supertanker ablaze, and Iran's strait authority has blacklisted 122 ships.

poly-ex-cuba-leader-raul-castro-in-us-cu.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Raúl Castro, Fidel's brother, Cuba's president from 2008 to 2018 and party chief until 2021, is in US custody by year's end. Traders bet on Washington getting him before an American court.

poly-kim-jong-un-out-as-supreme-leader-o.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Kim Jong Un stops being North Korea's leader before the year is out. Pyongyang says nothing about his health or succession, so long absences from public view are what traders bet on.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-texas-se.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Democrat wins the US Senate seat Texas fills in November 2026. Texas last elected a Democrat to the Senate in 1988, so the price shows how far bettors think the party's map has stretched.
poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-texas-se.recent: Nothing reported this fortnight touched the Texas race itself. The news around this contract was about the venue: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to rule on prediction markets, and Kalshi's chief said state-led oversight would push them out.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by the end of the year. The strait carries about a fifth of the world's oil and much of the Gulf's gas and fertilizer.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Iran's army said it fired on 3 ships and tied reopening the strait to its rights being respected, after calling the US response to its reopening proposal 'insufficient'. Since then Iran has offered to reopen within 6 days on its own terms, while the IRGC says mines set tankers ablaze and Iran's strait authority has blacklisted 122 ships.

wiki-anthropic.standing: The San Francisco AI company that makes the Claude models, founded in 2021 by former OpenAI staff. It is one of a handful of labs building frontier systems, and is structured as a public benefit corporation.
wiki-anthropic.recent: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue hit $16.8 billion, yet investors discussed a lower $1.5 trillion valuation as growth slowed, and a US regulator sent it and OpenAI more than 50 pages of questions. Nscale is in talks for a second $45 billion compute contract, and Anthropic will put 5% of its shares into a public fund.

stocks:MU.standing: An American maker of memory chips, DRAM and NAND flash, and one of three companies that make most of the world's DRAM. Its share price swings with the memory cycle and with demand for the high-bandwidth memory used in AI servers.
stocks:MU.recent: One of Micron's two unions in Taiwan called a strike for Thursday over bonuses. The dispute surfaced only after the fall had already happened, and nothing else reported in the period accounts for the decline.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital has long leaned toward the Kuomintang, so the price reads as a bet on the DPP taking it.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before November 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, and it moves on talks, strikes and sanctions.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Ukraine sent drones at a St Petersburg oil terminal, and Trump put on hold new Russia sanctions he had signed into law. Russia then hit 28 energy facilities, cutting power to 550,000 households. Putin proposed a summit with Trump and Xi that seats no Ukrainian, ahead of talks in Oslo with Witkoff.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the war pausing this year.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.recent: Trump put new Russia sanctions on hold, Germany and Ukraine pressed Putin to join a full energy-sector truce, Putin floated a summit with Trump and Xi that seats no Ukrainian, and Witkoff met Zelenskyy in Oslo before heading to Russia. The strikes went on: Russia hit 28 energy facilities, and Ukrainian drones burned oil at St Petersburg.

stocks:GOOGL.standing: The parent company of Google, earning most of its revenue from search and YouTube advertising, alongside Google Cloud and Waymo. Its share is a running bet on whether AI assistants strengthen or erode the search ad business.
stocks:GOOGL.recent: Google's own benchmarks put Claude 9 points ahead of its Gemini 4 Argon, staff testing Gemini 4 Carbon likened its coding to Opus 5.5, and Google signed as buyer for 890 megawatts of new nuclear output. None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders pay for a yes, and it moves with strikes, mediation and the Red Sea shipping the war hangs over.
poly-saudi-houthi-ceasefire-agreement-an.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting points to talks. Houthi strikes halted Riyadh's airport and killed recruits at a camp in Shabwa, while Egypt, Turkey and Britain lined up behind Riyadh's defence and the kingdom pushed its investor summit to 2027. None of it accounts for traders paying more for a truce.

poly-oil-below-85-on-november-2-and-the-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if both things happen: oil trades below $85 a barrel on November 2 and Democrats win control of the US Senate. Its price is what traders pay for that joint outcome.
poly-oil-below-85-on-november-2-and-the-.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets concerned who regulates them, not what this contract bets on: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to take up the question, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push the markets out. None of it bears on oil or on the Senate race.

poly-will-andrey-gyurov-win-the-2026-bul.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Gyurov takes between 20% and 30% of the first-round vote in Bulgaria's 2026 election. It is one band of several, so traders bet on the size of his share, not only on whether he wins.

stocks:CRWV.standing: A US cloud company that rents Nvidia graphics processors to AI developers, financed largely with debt secured against those chips. Its share price shows how much borrowed money the AI build-out can still attract.
stocks:CRWV.recent: Lenders grew nervous about CoreWeave's borrowing, and by the end of the fortnight its troubles were being read as a threat to the whole AI junk market, the high-yield debt that pays for the data-centre build-out. If that market shuts, the company loses the funding its expansion runs on.

poly-will-the-republican-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Republicans hold a majority of the US Senate after the 2026 midterms. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome; the Senate confirms judges, cabinet picks and treaties.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: Iran's ideological military force, answering to the Supreme Leader rather than the regular army. It runs its own navy in the Gulf, the Quds Force abroad and a large share of the economy.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: The Guards' navy claimed a run of mine strikes in Hormuz: tankers set ablaze, a ship carrying 2,500 containers sunk, 6 ships hit in one day. Britain blamed the IRGC for directing the RAF Fairford plot, and the Guards warned that undersea internet cables in the strait could become targets.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-octob.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire by 31 October 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on envoy trips, summit offers and strikes on cities and grids.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-octob.recent: Talk of a narrower energy-sector truce, which Germany and Ukraine want Putin to join, and Oslo talks where Witkoff pressed Kyiv for concessions kept a deal on the table. Fighting did not pause: Russia hit 28 energy facilities, cutting power to 550,000 households, and Ukrainian drones set a St Petersburg oil terminal alight.

wiki-france.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on France each day. Its peaks mark the days events in the country reached people well beyond its borders.
wiki-france.recent: Student protests over run-down schools grew into the worst unrest in decades: France suspended stun grenades for policing pupils, 161,500 marched, and Limoges's 1883 town hall burned. After nearly 2,400 arrests in one night, France imposed curfews and a Paris protest ban, and its borrowing costs hit their highest since 2002.

wiki-starlink.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Starlink, SpaceX's network of thousands of low-orbit satellites selling broadband to homes, ships, aircraft and armies, Ukraine's front-line drone units among them.
wiki-starlink.recent: The peak came as Musk accused Ambani of running India's satellite market and keeping Starlink from selling service there, a monopoly claim India rejected, and as SpaceX signed a low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile. Since then Kyiv says a SpaceX speed limit drops drone links at 110 km/h, and Starlink sites in 3 NATO states have been attacked by arsonists.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if the U.S. invades Iran before 2027. Its price is what traders will stake on a ground war, a step beyond the air and sea strikes a conflict can be fought with.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: The war ran through the sea, not over land. The Guards said mines set 2 tankers ablaze in Hormuz, Iran then offered to reopen the strait within 6 days, and Lavrov came to Tehran offering to mediate between Washington and Iran. None of it put U.S. troops on Iranian soil, which is what the contract pays on.

stocks:CNDT.standing: A US outsourcing firm spun off from Xerox in 2017 that runs back-office work for governments and companies: benefit payments, toll collection, health claims. Its shares move on state contracts and what they cost to run.

poly-will-any-country-join-the-mecca-agr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if any country formally joins the Mecca Agreement before 31 October. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, which makes it a running bet on whether the pact gains a new member.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: What traders pay for a contract that settles yes if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the two-round vote that chooses Emmanuel Macron's successor.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's top leadership changes before the year is out. Its price is what traders will stake on the Islamic Republic's rulers losing power, through war, succession or upheaval.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.recent: With the US-Iran war in its eighth month, parliament approved a sanctioned missile builder as defence minister, and Tehran set terms for reopening Hormuz as Lavrov offered to broker talks. None of it bears on who holds power in Tehran, and none of it accounts for the price.

stocks:3690.HK.standing: China's largest platform for food delivery and local services, from restaurant orders to hotel bookings, listed in Hong Kong. Its margins swing on subsidy wars with rivals and on Beijing's rules for delivery couriers.

wiki-openai.standing: The San Francisco company behind ChatGPT and the GPT models, founded in 2015 as a nonprofit research lab and now one of the largest commercial AI developers. Its releases and prices set the terms its rivals compete on.
wiki-openai.recent: An OpenAI engineer who had booked a one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia was charged after a thumb-sized recorder turned up behind a television in an executive conference room. Days earlier OpenAI released more than 350 mathematical findings in one day; a US regulator then sent it and Anthropic more than 50 pages of questions on security.

stocks:XYZ.standing: The company behind Square's card readers and software for small merchants and Cash App, a US peer-to-peer payments app. Its share moves with small-business and consumer spending, and it holds bitcoin on its balance sheet.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on him in a Democratic field with no clear leader.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire by May 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, sanctions and the war's own escalations.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Ukrainian and US negotiators met in Oslo, Witkoff went on to see Putin, and Trump put on hold new Russia sanctions he had signed into law. The energy truce Germany and Ukraine asked Putin to join did not take hold: Russia hit 28 energy facilities, and Ukrainian drones burned oil at St Petersburg.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-united-serbia.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Aleksandar Vučić's Serbian Progressive Party wins the most seats in Serbia's 2026 parliamentary election. The party has led every government in Belgrade since 2012.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-most-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Flávio Bolsonaro wins the most votes in Amapá, a small state in Brazil's far north, in the runoff. It prices one state's tally, not the national result.
poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-most-.recent: The news from Brazil's runoff in these weeks was about platforms, not Amapá: Meta admitted its AI generated images favouring Flávio Bolsonaro, and researchers logged over 1,000 Meta restrictions on political content. None of it concerns the state's vote or accounts for the betting.

stocks:AIR.PA.standing: The European airliner maker that splits the world's large-jet market with Boeing, listed in Paris. Its jet deliveries drive the share; a defence and space arm builds military aircraft, satellites and rocket parts.
stocks:AIR.PA.recent: The fortnight brought Airbus shipping the first lighter engine bay for Ariane 6 Block 2, which saves less weight than first planned, and the first flight of its U740 Valkyrie drone at Mach 0.8. Neither accounts for the share price.

poly-will-likud-win-the-most-seats-in-th.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Likud, Benjamin Netanyahu's party, wins more Knesset seats than any other list in Israel's 2026 election. The largest party is usually first asked to form a coalition.
poly-will-likud-win-the-most-seats-in-th.recent: The run-up to the vote brought a defamation suit from former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar, seeking 3 million shekels from Netanyahu over October 7; an EU rebuke over settler attacks on diplomats that Netanyahu called a smear; and an unannounced visit from Pete Hegseth days before the election. None of it accounts for the bets moving against Likud.

stocks:8473.T.standing: A Tokyo financial group that runs SBI Securities, Japan's largest online brokerage, alongside banking, asset management and crypto businesses. Its share follows Japanese retail trading volumes and the group's digital-asset bets.

stocks:055550.KS.standing: One of South Korea's largest financial groups, owner of Shinhan Bank, Shinhan Card and insurance and brokerage arms. Its share tracks Korean interest rates, household credit and the won.
stocks:055550.KS.recent: The one story in the input about Shinhan's own business was a plan, still at the looking stage, to let Japanese visitors pay in Korea with yen stablecoins. Nothing in it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether a US-Iran agreement reached in 2026 has Iran hand over its stockpile of enriched uranium, the material at the centre of the nuclear dispute and of any settlement between the two.
poly-will-a-us-iran-deal-in-2026-include.recent: Mediators are shuttling between the two sides. Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir carried their proposals to Tehran and was told that no enriched uranium will leave Iran, the sticking point in any deal to end the US-Israeli war on Iran. A day earlier Lavrov offered in Tehran to broker US-Iran talks.
